title: 生涯スポーツ演習(サイクリング)
subtitle: Academic Exercises on Lifelong Sports
courseType:
Student and Study Skills Courses Program
Character Building Courses
Lifelong Sports
educationalGoal: By studying the fundamental skills of cycling, students will learn the following: 1. The enjoyment of sports throughout their lifetime.2. The knowledge and ability to practice various sports activities voluntarily and through their own initiative based on the Plan-Do-Check-Action (PDCA) cycle.3. Necessities for social/student life such as the observation of rules, respect and kindness forothers,acompetitive spirit, leadership/cooperation, a sense of responsibility, safety awareness, and communication skills.
advice: This class aims to achieve the above-mentioned learning objectives through cycling activities. The cycling activity involves an approximately 260-km, 3-day return trip from the Nonoichi to the Notojima campus and back to take place or Nonoichi to Fukui and back to take place (240km) in early- to mid-September. Specifically, students will learn the following: (1) Basic cycling knowledge (2) Basic cycling skills (3) Cycling safety measures (4) How to plan a cycling tour ・A participation fee including the cost of accommodation, food, insurance, etc., is required . ・Students must prepare and maintain their own bicycle and equipment (e.g., gloves, spats, etc.). ・It is recommended that the bicycle is a mountain or road bike with a multiple derailleur system. ・Because this class involves an outdoor activity, there will be a focus on attendance attitudes(timeschedule,traffic rules, etc.). Students should place much emphasis on observing the rules to ensure safety. ・Details will be explained at the briefing session. An orientation program will be held before the cycling tour.
requiredKnowledge: Understanding the mental attitude and safety precautions needed in sports activities. Preparation for learning sports activities and taking appropriate safety measures. Because this activity covers a long distance, students should be accustomed to riding a bicycle, ideally over long distances.

activityGoals.body: Be able to express the importance of enjoying an active sports lifestyle throughout your lifetime.
Be able to learn the fundamental skills needed for cycling and use them in class activities.
Be able to evaluate and explain your own situation and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle
Be able to understand the necessities for social life and implement them in class activities.
Be able to express problems and make improvements that promote a healthy lifestyle by assessing your daily life.
Be able to understand safety management in sports and implement this understanding in learning activities.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Accurately express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime. (2) Learn fundamental cycling skills and utilize them fully in class activities. (3) Accurately evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle. (4) Understand the necessities for social life and implement them in class activities. (5) Accurately express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits. (6) Understand safety management in sports activities and implement this understanding in learning activities.
achievementLevels.standard: (1) Roughly express the importance of enjoying an active lifestyle throughout one's own lifetime. (2) Learn fundamental cycling skills and utilize them roughly in class activities. (3) Roughly evaluate and explain personal/team situations and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle. (4) Understand the necessities for social life and roughly implement them in class activities. (5) Roughly express one's own problems and improvements in regard to a healthy lifestyle through the self-evaluation of daily habits. (6) Understand safety management in sports activities and roughly implement this understanding in learning activities.

lessons.content: Guidance 1. Confirm the important points learned in the training 2. Explain schedules, tools, and expenses Pre-event Training 1. About Heatstroke 2. About Bicycle Riding Rules and Etiquette

Cycling training for 3 days and 2 nights 1. Ensure safe riding (in four groups). 2. On the second day, orientation will be held in Notojima(Fukui). 3. Confirm the contents of learning and safe riding during the training period. 4. Explain submissions such as reports and portfolio assignments in the dormitory on the second day.
lessons.operation: Outdoor training Group behavior Self-inspection after arriving at the dormitory and KIT
lessons.assignments: Create and submit a report by the designated date. Create a lifestyle self-administration sheet.
